# localization.pint_locale { #keecas.localization.pint_locale }

`pint_locale`

Pint locale management and synchronization with keecas language settings.

This module handles locale detection, configuration, and automatic synchronization
between keecas language settings and Pint unit formatting.

## Functions

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [update_pint_locale](#keecas.localization.pint_locale.update_pint_locale) | Update pint locale based on keecas language setting with smart mode detection. |

### update_pint_locale { #keecas.localization.pint_locale.update_pint_locale }

```python
update_pint_locale(unitregistry, language=None, verbose=False)
```

Update pint locale based on keecas language setting with smart mode detection.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type                 | Description                                                | Default    |
|--------------|----------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| unitregistry | [Any](`typing.Any`)  | The Pint UnitRegistry instance                             | _required_ |
| language     | [str](`str`) \| None | Two-letter language code. If None, gets from keecas config | `None`     |
| verbose      | [bool](`bool`)       | If True, print debugging information about locale changes  | `False`    |

#### Notes {.doc-section .doc-section-notes}

- Automatically switches to manual mode if user intervention is detected
- Respects disable_pint_locale configuration setting
- Handles fallback scenarios for unsupported languages
